title: 第9章 欺人太甚第10章 称霸杂役弟子新人区
content_zh:
第9章欺人太甚！
出了矿洞，两人专门往人多的地方走，希望能让严衡忌惮，让他不敢过快动手。
谁知，林浩他们的举动，正合严衡的心意，越多的人看着，越适合他立威。
甚至在遇到其他新杂役弟子的时候，他还直接叫住，让新杂役弟子跟着一起走，好围观他暴揍林浩和王富的威风场面。
迫于严衡的虎威，那些新的杂役弟子，只得硬着头皮跟了上去。
“林浩，王富，你俩给我站住。”
见周围的人已经很多，严衡淡淡的开口，带着不容置疑的语气道。
“要开始了吗？林浩这次惨了。”
其他杂役弟子，有的幸灾乐祸抱着看热闹的心态，而有的则是感同身受，报以同情的目光。
“你想干什么？”
林浩知道躲不过，他深吸口气，强做镇定的停下脚步转身道。
他目前才修炼到炼气一重，而严衡则是早已进入炼气一重，距离炼气二重也不远。
虽然师父长生仙尊说，五行灵根比同境界的人厉害，但他也有些没底。
“干什么？林浩，你这五行灵根的废物明知故问吗？呵呵，这些日子你们过的很舒服啊！
让你严爷爷少喝了多少灵粥。”
严衡冷哼一声，脸上露出凶狠之色，眼中寒芒一闪道：“你们俩给我跪下，叫声严爷爷我错了，乖乖挨老子的拳头，方可让我平息怒火。”
“大家都是同门，没必要做得这么绝吧！”
林浩脸色微微一变，要他跪下挨揍叫爷爷，这么屈辱的事情，他说什么也不肯。
“严衡……严老大，您大人有大量，放过我们吧！”
王富被严衡凶恶的气势，吓得一个哆嗦，忍不住求饶道。

“跪还是不跪？”
严衡当着其他围观的杂役弟子面，对着林浩和王富猛地大喝一声道：“否则你严爷爷，今天揍死你们。”
“噗通，我……我错了。”
王富想到以前和严衡作对的杂役弟子凄惨下场，迫于严衡的凶威，实在顶不住。
本着大丈夫能屈能伸的想法，跪在了地上。
“林浩，轮到你了。”
严衡看小胖子已经被逼得下跪，他眼睛微微一眯，闪烁着危险的气息，冷笑着道。
周围大量杂役弟子围观，看严衡教训两人，却没人敢出声干预。
“想让我跪下，没门。”
林浩死死的握着拳头。
这一刻，修仙界的弱肉强食，在他心中是那么强烈。
他想服软，可跪下也要挨打，严衡实力也在炼气一重，和他同境界，并不是强大到令人绝望，还不如拼了。
“老子非揍得你满地找牙。”
见林浩还敢嘴硬，严衡大吼一声，话语刚落，身体便猛地冲出直奔林浩而去，他右手握拳，狠狠的挥动，在强大的拳劲下，空气不断响起音爆声。
强大的速度，可怕的气势，让周围围观的其他杂役弟子，都忍不住变色，这一拳若是砸在他们身上，恐怕会疼得他们满地打滚。
“以后，说什么也不能招惹严衡。”
许多杂役弟子，脸上浮现出畏惧之色，心中暗暗想道。
“严衡，你太过分了。”
林浩看着杀气腾腾冲来，要下重手的严衡，他双目赤红，一副被逼急了的样子。
他和普通人打过不少架，这和修仙者打架他还是第一次，他握着拳头，体内灵气调动起来，大吼一声：“我跟你拼了。”

林浩满脸狰狞，生怕自己不是对手，体内五行灵根远比同境界灵根雄厚的灵力，疯狂流转，全力爆发。
第9章欺人太甚！
“碰！”
拼命之下，林浩拳头可怕的速度和气势，甚至比严衡还快许多，两人的拳头触碰在一起。
content_en:
Chapter 9: Bullying goes too far!
After leaving the mine, the two of them walked specifically to a crowded place, hoping to scare Yan Heng away and prevent him from taking action too quickly.
Unexpectedly, Lin Hao and the others' actions were exactly what Yan Heng wanted. The more people watched, the more suitable it would be for him to establish his authority.
Even when he met other new handyman disciples, he directly stopped him and asked the new handyman disciples to follow them so that they could watch the majestic scene of him beating up Lin Hao and Wang Fu.
Forced by Yan Heng's power, the new handyman disciples had no choice but to follow him.
"Lin Hao, Wang Fu, you two, stop here."
Seeing that there were already many people around, Yan Heng spoke calmly, with an unquestionable tone.
"Are we going to start? Lin Hao is in trouble this time."
Some of the other handyman disciples were gloating about the misfortune and watching the fun, while others felt the same and responded with sympathetic looks.
"What do you want to do?"
Lin Hao knew he couldn't escape, so he took a deep breath, forced himself to stop and turned around.
He has only reached the first level of Qi refining at present, while Yan Heng has already entered the first level of Qi refining, and is not far from the second level of Qi refining.
Although Master Changsheng Immortal Lord said that the Five Elements Spiritual Roots are more powerful than people of the same realm, he is still a little unsure.
"What are you doing? Lin Hao, you five-element spirit root waste, are you asking questions knowingly? Haha, you are living very comfortably these days!
Let your grandpa Yan drink less spiritual porridge. "
Yan Heng snorted coldly, with a fierce look on his face, and a cold light flashed in his eyes: "Kneel down, you two, and shout, "Grandpa Yan, I was wrong. Only by accepting my fist obediently can I calm down my anger."
"We are all from the same sect, so there is no need to be so awesome!"
Lin Hao's expression changed slightly. He asked him to kneel down and be beaten and call him grandpa. He refused to do anything such a humiliating thing.
"Yan Heng...Boss Yan, you have a lot, please let us go!"
Wang Fu was so frightened by Yan Heng's ferocious aura that he couldn't help but beg for mercy.
"Kneel or not kneel?"
Yan Heng shouted loudly at Lin Hao and Wang Fu in front of other onlookers, "Grandpa Yan, I will beat you to death today."
"Pfft, I...I was wrong."
Wang Fu thought of the miserable fate of the handyman disciples who had opposed Yan Heng before, and he couldn't stand it under Yan Heng's fierce power.
In line with the idea that a man can bend and stretch, he knelt on the ground.
"Lin Hao, it's your turn."
Yan Heng saw that the little fat man had been forced to kneel down. His eyes narrowed slightly, flashing with a dangerous aura, and he sneered.
A large number of handyman disciples were watching, watching Yan Heng teach the two men, but no one dared to intervene.
"You want me to kneel down, no way."
Lin Hao clenched his fist tightly.
At this moment, the idea of ​​the weak and the strong in the world of immortality was so strong in his heart.
He wanted to surrender, but he would be beaten even if he knelt down. Yan Heng was also at the first level of Qi Refining. At the same level as him, he was not so powerful that he was desperate, so he might as well fight.
"I will beat you until you have teeth all over the floor."
Seeing that Lin Hao still dared to speak harshly, Yan Heng roared. As soon as he finished speaking, his body rushed out and went straight towards Lin Hao. He made a fist with his right hand and waved it fiercely. Under the powerful force of the fist, the air kept ringing with sonic booms.
The powerful speed and terrifying momentum caused the other handyman disciples who were watching around to change their colors. If this punch hit them, they would probably roll on the ground in pain.
"From now on, you can say nothing to provoke Yan Heng."
Many handyman disciples had a look of fear on their faces and thought secretly in their hearts.
"Yan Heng, you have gone too far."
Lin Hao looked at Yan Heng, who was charging towards him with murderous intent and was about to strike hard. His eyes were red and he looked like he was being forced into panic.
He had fought many times with ordinary people, but this was his first fight with a cultivator. He clenched his fists, mobilized the spiritual energy in his body, and yelled: "I'll fight you."
Lin Hao's face was full of ferocity, fearing that he was no match. The five elements spiritual roots in his body were far stronger than those of the same realm.The thick spiritual power circulates crazily and explodes with all its strength.
Chapter 9: Bullying goes too far!
"Touch!"
With all his strength, Lin Hao's fists showed terrifying speed and momentum, even faster than Yan Heng's, and their fists touched together.
